title: MonHub | Item Autofarm, AutoSell, Auto ServerHop and more!
features:
MonHub - One of the best YBA Autofarm scripts existing rn. Working AutoFarm, AutoSell and way more features for farming money [Xeno / Solara are unsupported, sorry.]

List of Features:

Farming
- Auto Farm Items
- Pick up filter by item, minimum rarity and priority
- Auto Server Hop when the server is empty
- Auto Sell with item picker and Don't Sell Rare Items (keeps Lucky Arrows and Lucky Stone Masks)
- Auto Buy Lucky Arrows
- Auto Item Machine
- Session stats dashboard
- Discord webhook for pickups, kicks, hops and session summary

Visuals
- Item highlights, names, and some cool visuals
- Player ESP: name, distance, health, stand and level, boxes
- Character and player chams
- Custom skybox, fullbright, no fog, time of day, FOV

Player
- Walk speed, fly, noclip, anti time stop
- Teleports to NPCs, players and places

Performance
- Farm Screen - hides the world and shows your stats, perfect for many accounts [Saves PC resources]
- Remove map, low graphics, no particles, no post effects, FPS cap
- Anti AFK and auto press play button after rejoin
